title: ¿Por qué tu cinta métrica no se dobla? 📏
engine_reason: Drawn route (hard surfaces only, one hero rig): a tape measure is a rigid mechanism (blade, hook, housing, spring) with an animated cross-section; modelled hard-surface in the dark-stage reference look, PBR materials, EEVEE drafts and Cycles finals; labels, counters, chips, CTA and end card are Editor overlays.
hook_question: ¿Por qué tu cinta métrica se queda recta en el aire, si una tira plana de metal se doblaría al instante?
false_belief: Que una cinta métrica es solo una regla enrollada y que su gancho suelto está roto.
closing_reframe: Una cinta métrica no es una regla enrollada: es una viga que se despliega, y por eso aguanta peso.
share_archetype: ese amigo que jura que el gancho suelto está roto
style: Not used: code3d scenes are rendered in Blender from the visual_identity block (dark stage, exact hex values).

background.description: near-black warm void, dark low-key stage

visual_identity.lighting: low-key, one soft key light, warm orange rim halo behind the hero near the top of the frame, emissive accents as the second light, soft shadows, dark vignette toward the edges
visual_identity.materials: simplified chunky smooth-shaded models, matte/satin with a faint specular, emissive glowing tubes for energy, flat clean cross-section cuts, no outlines, no cel bands, no photo textures

scenes.name: spring-motor
scenes.prompt: Exploded housing: the gold spiral spring winds as the blade is pulled out and unwinds when released; a brake pad presses the blade.
scenes.narration: Dentro hay un resorte plano en espiral: es el motor. Se tensa cuando sacas la cinta, y siempre quiere volver. Al soltarla, se destensa y la recoge de golpe. El seguro no sostiene nada: solo frena al resorte.
scenes.transformation: housing closed -> shell lifted, spring winds as the blade is pulled, recoils on release, brake holds
scenes.camera: camera orbits the exploded housing with a slow push-in
